title: IELTS PREPARATION COURSE – EXTENSIVE COURSE
overview: This 15-day extensive IELTS preparation programme provides a concentrated, practice-driven route to stronger performance in the International English Language Testing System (IELTS). It develops the language skills, task familiarity, examination techniques and confidence required for Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking. Participants work with Academic or General Training materials according to their intended test pathway, complete timed practice, receive criterion-based feedback and build an individual improvement plan. The course is designed for intensive preparation; improvement depends on participants’ entry level and independent practice.
audience: University and scholarship applicants; professionals requiring IELTS results for employment, licensing or migration; learners preparing for IELTS Academic or General Training; and candidates who need a focused, structured preparation period before their test date. Entry-level diagnostic assessment is recommended.
methodology: Diagnostic assessment; instructor-led language and examination strategy workshops; targeted drills; authentic-style task practice; pair and small-group speaking activities; timed writing assignments; annotated model answers; feedback against IELTS public band descriptors; practice tests; error-log reviews; and guided independent study between sessions.
competencies: Understanding IELTS formats, timing, question types and assessment criteria
Identifying main ideas, supporting details, speakers’ attitudes and distractors in listening tasks
Reading efficiently through skimming, scanning, inference and evidence checking
Producing well-structured Task 1 and Task 2 responses for the appropriate test pathway
Speaking with fluency, coherence, relevant vocabulary and intelligible pronunciation
Using grammar and lexical resources accurately under time pressure
Monitoring performance through feedback, error analysis and realistic score targets
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Explain the IELTS test structure and distinguish Academic from General Training requirements.
Apply listening and reading strategies to complete common question formats accurately and efficiently.
Plan, write and revise Task 1 and Task 2 answers with attention to task achievement, organization, vocabulary and grammar.
Respond effectively to all three Speaking parts using developed answers and clear, natural interaction.
Use time allocation, checking routines and test-day procedures to reduce avoidable errors.
Interpret feedback and mock-test results to prioritize further preparation before the examination.
